g.text: Each integer cutoff on this plot is certified.
Lines join integer values; there is no noninteger-cutoff claim.
Coefficients retain all original Gamma weights and moments.
The original real-pair inverse: every cutoff, both exact spectra
Proof RPAC1–15. A finite certificate proves nonresonance through D=100; the all-degree formulas retain both cases.
Original period and Gamma dictionary: PCL1–16 and WCF1–6. Inclusion arithmetic: Fredrik Johansson, Arb, arXiv:1611.02831v1.
